reviews.title: Best cooler yet on the market
reviews.comment:
This was better than the single core thermalright cooler. I changed out the fans to red dragon rgb fans that daisy chain to a single connector this cooler makes the processor much more cooler. I’m not a hard core gamers but I do play some graphics games like stalkers 2 and still the pc don’t exceeded over 60c now at a normal idle pc runs at 30c. This best cooler on the market and I would highly recommend to anyone is in to gaming or running a hot cpu.  My spec’s are below
MSi B550 MAG tomahawk with WiFi
AMD Ryzen 7 5600X3D
XFX SPEEDSTER SWFT 210 Radeon RX 6600
Patriot Viper Steel RGB DDR4 RAM 4X16
Pc fans are
AsiaHorse AMICI-5GT RGB PC Fans, Infinity Mirror
And on the radiator are
Redragon GCF012
reviews.author: DAVID Rowe

reviews.title: 10/10 product, highly recommended.
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1ix8h9ORkL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61aSC3N9gFL._SY256.jpg Everything Thermalright touches turns to gold! Stellar performance from this AIO. Swapped in different fans from the Hyper Vision model as I had a surplus on hand, but the stock fans perform just as well.
Software is incredibly granular and easy to use, performance from this model is stellar on the 7800x3D and 9800x3D. In these images it is cooling a 5800x3D specifically.
10/10, would recommend this to anyone looking for an AIO with an LCD!

reviews.title: THERE IS NO WARRANTY!!!
reviews.comment:
This company refused to uphold their warranty. I have been going back and forth them because the LCD Screen never worked. I even had to show them pictures of how it was hooked up and also sending them pictures of me testing the product. They offered me $20. To buy another LCD screen for the cooler instead of sending me another one. And $20. doesn’t even cover anything. So, DO NOT BUY ANYTHING FROM THERMALRIGHT, THERE IS NO WARRANTY!!!
So, I’m going to try to work with Amazon to get this seller off of Amazon seller list.
reviews.author: Joe P
